description: This file defines API routes for interacting with the Congress.gov API within a FastAPI application. It includes functions for retrieving bill lists, bill document URLs, detailed bill info, and bill text content, with associated API documentation and example usage.

methods.name: OBBject bills( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieve and filter lists of Congressional Bills based on provided parameters.

methods.name: list bill_text_urls( bill_url: str, provider: str = "congress_gov", is_workspace: bool = False, )
methods.description: Get document choices (PDFs or text) for a specific bill URL, used within the Congressional Bills Viewer widget.

methods.name: OBBject bill_info( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Get summary, status, and metadata for a specific bill URL.

methods.name: OBBject bill_text( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Download the content of bills from URLs, returning either the raw data or widget-compatible results.
